# synology_user (Resource)

A local DSM account and its group memberships. Import requires no password. Passwords are write-only and cannot be drift-detected. Built-in and currently authenticated accounts cannot be deleted.

## Adopt existing settings

1. Add the import block below with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.
2. Set your arguments to the values DSM currently reports. The sample configuration shows the shape and uses example values.
3. Run `terraform plan`. For one import, apply only when it reports `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_user.reader
  id = "reader"
}
```

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_user" "reader" {
  name                = "reader"
  description         = "Archive reader"
  groups              = ["users", "team"]
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Local DSM account name and import identifier.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Reject deletion using the last applied value. Disable in a separate apply before intentionally deleting a custom account.
- `description` (String) Account description. An empty value clears it.
- `email` (String) Account email address. An empty value clears it.
- `expiration` (String) DSM account state: normal, now (disabled), or a DSM expiration date. Imported dates are preserved exactly.
- `groups` (Set of String) Authoritative local group membership, including the implicit users group. Omit to preserve existing membership. References to synology_group names establish creation order.
- `password_version` (Number) Increase to rotate password_wo. Zero leaves the imported password unchanged. This counter does not detect external password changes.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password used only for creation or an explicit password_version change. Omit on import. Never persisted in plan or state.

### Read-Only

- `uid` (Number) Numeric DSM user identifier.
